neighbours.label: a preposition right before an expected 'fertilization / conception / ovulation' (the time of, chances of, after)
fire: Doctors can estimate the date of conception from the first scan.
Timing intercourse well raises the chances of conception.
The fertilized egg divides about a day after fertilization.
Basal body temperature rises slightly at the moment of ovulation.
Cells in the early embryo remain identical for a few days after conception.
Hormone levels peak just before the time of ovulation.
The zona pellucida hardens at fertilization to block other sperm.
Twins can form within two weeks of conception.
quiet: Doctors can estimate the size of the baby from the first scan.
Eating well raises the chances of a healthy birth weight.
The mother usually goes home about a day after delivery.
Basal body temperature is measured each morning with a thermometer.
Cells in the early embryo divide every twelve hours or so.
Hormone levels are checked during the first visit to the clinic.
The placenta grows quickly in the second month of pregnancy.
Twins are usually delivered a few weeks early.

notes: Probe: 'time of ovulation' 0.64, 'week after fertilization' 0.96, 'days of the week' 0.01. Output suppresses ' conception', ' fertil'; the + pole is 'embry'/'Emb'.
